items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I grew up in a place called Port Chester, New York, near Connecticut, and this was in the Yonkers area where Ahmad Jamal lives.

ctx.x: I grew up in a place called Port Chester, New York, near Connecticut, and this was in the Yonkers area where Ahmad Jamal lives. And there was a bunch of black guys, older. They were good players, they were beboppers and you know, they weren’t famous or anything. And we’d get together every week and I was only maybe 15, 14 years old. Just to play.
And if they played a tune, let’s say you went to one session and they called “How High the Moon” and you didn’t know it. How did you learn it for next time?
